get_block:
get:
      tags: [Chat]
      operationId: getSessionShareMetadata
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-bff
      x-kokoro-visibility: public
      x-kokoro-stability: beta
      x-kokoro-idempotency: none
      x-kokoro-permission: chat.read
      summary: Read the current owned session share
      description: Read-only owner metadata. An accessible unshared, revoked or expired session returns share null; inaccessible sessions return the same not-found result. Never creates a share or updates expiry state.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/DirectScopeQuery'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ProjectRefQuery'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Current active share or an accessible unshared session.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/SessionShareMetadataResponse' }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
        '429':
          description: IAM session admission is rate limited
          headers:
            Retry-After:
              description: Bounded delay in seconds before retrying admission
              schema: { type: string, pattern: '^[1-9][0-9]{0,4}$' }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
        '503': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable' }
schema_block:
SessionShareMetadata:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [share_id, created_at, expires_at]
      properties:
        share_id: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        expires_at: { type: [string, 'null'], format: date-time }
    SessionShareMetadataResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [data, meta]
      properties:
        data:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [share]
          properties:
            share:
              oneOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SessionShareMetadata'
                - type: 'null'
        meta: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RequestMeta' }
